summary: First-pass full-stack testing of Filed (Education Due Diligence Platform). Backend /api/insights with Claude Sonnet 4.5 working end-to-end; 6/6 pytest cases pass. All 10 homepage sections render; navigation, comparison engine remove+add flow, disclosure picker, live LLM insight generation on both / and /compare verified. Colleges, Factsheet, Compare and Methodology pages all load and behave correctly. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Logger reference at line 138 (logger.error) is used before logger is defined (logger init is below app.include_router at line 153). If the exception path triggers before logger is bound, a NameError could shadow the original error. Recommend moving logging.basicConfig + logger definition above the route handlers.

action_items: (Minor) In /app/backend/server.py, move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the /api/insights handler so the error-path logger.error() is guaranteed to be bound at import time. Currently works because Python resolves names at call-time and the module finishes loading before requests come in, but it's fragile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined after the routes that use it (line 153 vs use at line 138). Works in practice but is poor ordering.
server.py: /api/insights does not validate maximum colleges count; very large payloads will inflate LLM token usage. Consider capping at e.g. 6.

ComparisonEngine.jsx: `comp-add-btn` only renders when ids.length < 4 (gated by AddPicker). This matches spec ('clicking X removes, then Add institution shows') but verified flow requires removing a college first.
Insight generation has no client-side timeout/loading indicator visible in screenshots; consider showing spinner state while LLM is running (5-15s).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this prototype
seed_data_creation: None — mock data is bundled in /app/frontend/src/data/colleges.js (16 institutions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_filed_api.py covers: GET /api/, POST /api/insights (2 colleges, 3 colleges, empty 400, missing field 422, forbidden-words tone check). Live LLM call adds ~5s/test. Frontend coverage: home page (all 10 sections, hero CTAs, market landscape tooltip, 6 category cards, source badges, disclosure picker, comparison remove+add, live insight generation), /colleges (16 rows, search, type filter, sort), /college/iit-bombay factsheet, /compare (4 cols + live LLM insights + best-value emerald highlights), /methodology. No critical issues. Category cards are themselves <Link> wrappers (the data-testid is on the anchor) — so 0 children matched 'a' selector but the cards do navigate correctly (verified href=/college/jnu).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs to RCA. All flows operational.
